Package qupath.ext.omero.gui.browser

package qupath.ext.omero.gui.browser
This package contains menus and windows to browse an OMERO server.
  • The browse menu can launch windows allowing to create a new connection to an OMERO server or browse a known OMERO server
  • The BrowserCommand allows to start the browser.
  • The browser can browse an OMERO server, get information about OMERO entities and open OMERO images.
